# BoundedIntText { #anylumino.BoundedIntText }

```python
BoundedIntText(
    value=0,
    min=0,
    max=100,
    step=1,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
)
```

Bounded integer text input control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default    |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `0` |
| min | optional | Minimum numeric, date, or time value. | `0` |
| max | optional | Maximum numeric, date, or time value. | `100` |
| step | optional | Increment size. | `1` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.BoundedIntText.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
